changes.summary: Supervise provider smoke checks with inherited process ownership and clean detached descendants after timeout or exit
Add exact Google Generative AI profiles and supported thinking settings for six stable Gemini Flash models
Report structured provider failure details without reflecting credentials or untrusted terminal output
Render fixed-length positional correction arrays with explicit object item shapes while retaining their exact tuple constraints
Bind category-compatible ProductDefinition decision repairs to exact candidates and decode structured correction values only under their target schema
Collapse a broadly malformed model-owned proposal into one exact typed correction slot instead of duplicating many expanded leaf schemas
Compile an empty model-facing assumption relation into both empty persisted compatibility indexes during targeted correction
Keep the previous managed sandbox image addressable until staged activation or rollback settles and preserve both owned causes when recovery fails
Continue quality and delivery when a downstream Integration Agent proves that the exact clean upstream commit already satisfies its assigned work
Lower each run's effective Agent concurrency to current Linux memory and PID headroom without changing the saved user maximum
Give every semantic Planning correction a distinct run-scoped OpenClaw session generation across dialogue and revision cycles
Give cold OpenClaw configuration validation its own bounded timeout and retain the exact failed preflight command and failure class
Recover an explicit user-owned product decision as a focused clarification after sibling proposal validation errors no longer mask it
Replace a proposal graph atomically when malformed records leave no valid identities for safe reference-level correction
Correct every unordered overlapping writer pair in the proposal before compiling the approved runtime team plan
Constrain every Review criterion reference and targeted finding correction to the exact assigned scope
Replace Planning acceptance criteria together with every existing product-definition reference and task coverage relation
Retain attributable terminal session evidence after a nonzero OpenClaw exit and accept only a fully bound typed submission
